data.name: Sandip katore
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sandip katore has made a big mark in cricket. With 77 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 68, with an average of 16.34 and a quick strike rate of 176.41. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 67 sixes and 96 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 69.4 overs, taking 37 wickets at an economy rate of 10.25. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
